visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair and clear, radiant skin smiles warmly at the camera in a close-up shot. She is positioned in a bright indoor setting with soft, warm background lighting and a white wall behind her. (2) The camera zooms in as she points her index finger at her glowing cheek. A small, white animated sunburst graphic appears at the point of contact to emphasize the skin's hydration. (3) Two Dior cosmetic products, a silver pump bottle and a white jar, are shown resting on a clean, white textured fabric. (4) The woman holds the silver bottle next to her face, smiling broadly. She then dispenses a small amount of liquid serum onto her hand. (5) She gently applies the serum to her face using circular motions, looking directly into the camera with a relaxed and satisfied expression. (6) The woman opens the white cream jar and applies the product to her cheeks and forehead, massaging it in slowly. (7) A final shot shows her leaning her head on her hand, holding both products while smiling confidently. She is now wearing a white off-the-shoulder garment.
